blind.B1: Series is a mouse disuse model (knee immobilization + tail-suspension unloading, MMS), not exercise (S4.2.p1, S2.1.p1). R1 = joint motion resumed, R2 = motion + weight bearing restored after 2 wk (S2.2.p1) are re-mobilization/reloading, the only loading-restoration arms. No sample carries an exercise factor in the strict sense; at most an in-vivo 'reloading' analogue.
blind.B2: Paper compares Control vs MMS D3/D7/D14/D28 plus R1 and R2, shown as heatmaps/modules (Figs 2-3, S2.3.p1/S2.4.p1); D3/D7/D14/D28/R1/R2 各 n=2,共14样本; n=2 mice per group (S4.7.p1).
blind.B3: One mouse per sample, both knees pooled (S4.7.p1); different time points are different mice; no animal sampled twice. No pairing key in packet A (none found).
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint vs pairwise; DEG called by BGI PoissonDis service, groups vs control (S4.7.p1).
blind.B5: 'Genes with a fold change ≥ 2.0 and FDR ≤ 0.001 were defined as differentially expressed' (S4.7.p1). No DEG counts reported; S4.8.p2 separately selects FPKM>1 and FC (MMS D28/control) <0.67 or >1.5 giving 1606 genes.

checks.evidence: Refusal matches B1: disuse model, no exercise arm; R1/R2 have no paper DEG result (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1).
Stopped before DE; alignment exact on title key, levels match paper n (2/group).
One mouse per sample (S4.7.p1); no repeated measures; packet A lists no candidate key.
No model fitted; paper silent on joint vs pairwise.
No DE run; males only, same housing per S4.1.p1.
Non-integer, min ~0.5, 1% integer, row count 1606 equals S4.8.p2 FC-selected set; FPKM subset selected on the MMS D28/control outcome so DE is circular.
paper_threshold FC>=2 (log2 1), FDR<=0.001 inclusive matches S4.7.p1 verbatim.
HANDBACK claims no DEG counts; paper reports none.
Reason (feature-selected FPKM subset, no genome-wide counts) is true and checked against S4.8.p2 and file profile; 'no exercise arm' also holds.

human_items: Policy: whether R1/R2 reloading-vs-MMS in a disuse model counts as an exercise-like study; deposited matrix is feature-selected so not analyzable either way.
summary: 拒绝运行的决定成立:该数据是废用(固定+尾悬吊)模型,无运动组;已存矩阵是按结局(MMS D28/对照 FC)预筛选的 1606 基因 FPKM 子集,任何差异检验都是循环的。分组、n、阈值转录均与论文一致,无阻断或重大问题。
